product.name: Aurelio ProType 104
product.description: The Aurelio ProType 104 is a full‑size mechanical keyboard designed for both productivity and gaming. It features a sturdy aluminum frame with a detachable wrist rest, and 104 keycaps made from high‑density PBT. The keyboard supports RGB per‑key lighting with multiple preset profiles and a dedicated macro layer. Connectivity is via a single USB‑C port, delivering a reliable, low‑latency connection to modern laptops and desktops. The ProType 104 offers tactile Cherry MX Brown switches, a quiet typing experience, and a 1‑year warranty for peace of mind. Its compact layout and durable construction make it suitable for office work, creative projects, and competitive play.
